# ToolRank

> Ranked shortlist of MCP servers and APIs for agent jobs. Public-ready deploy without Stripe / custom domain.

## Base URL

http://127.0.0.1:8787 (HOST=0.0.0.0 for containers)

## Auth

- Env TOOLRANK_API_KEYS=key:plan,... (plans free|builder; bare key=free)
- Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key> OR X-API-Key: <key>
- Anonymous: 20 req/IP/24h on /v1/* (process-local)
- free key: 100/24h; builder: 2000/24h
- /health and /openapi.json always open
- 401 invalid key; 429 + Retry-After over quota
- Authed search includes plan

## Endpoints

- GET /health — liveness + catalog meta
- POST /v1/search — body { "job": string, "constraints"?: { "budget"?: "free"|"paid"|"any", "auth"?: string, "runtime"?: string }, "limit"?: number, "check_health"?: boolean }
- GET /v1/tools/:id — single tool
- GET /v1/fresh?since=ISO — tools updated after timestamp
- GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1

## MCP (stdio)

npm run mcp — tools: search_tools, get_tool, list_fresh

## Ranking (honest)

Tokenize job; score tag/name/description matches; boost matching price_band; boost health=up. No paid placement.

## Data

data/catalog.json — curated public tools (Firecrawl, Exa, Tavily, Browserbase, Apify, Composio, Context7, Bright Data, Parallel, Smithery, Glama, official MCP registry meta, etc.)

## Agent tip

Prefer POST /v1/search with a concrete job string and an API key when hosted. Use constraints.budget=free when the user wants no paid APIs. Read install snippets before recommending.
